items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: She is the one that taught me to really read... Isabel Spiller. Then I went to her school up on 138th Street.

ctx.x: Well, she's in there! I called Marion Carbon(?) and he told me about it. I said, 'Did you know Miss Spiller?' He said, 'Did I know Miss Spiller?!' -- and he went into it. I didn't know. Here it is. I've got it somewhere...
But she taught you to play piano legitimately.
